# Fovea Studio

> Independent AI-powered lyric video maker and animated typography studio.

Fovea Studio (https://fovea.si) transforms songs into release-ready lyric videos and animated typography. It enables musicians, songwriters, and Suno creators to produce professional, word-synced visuals for YouTube, TikTok, Instagram Reels, and X without manual keyframing or video editing software.

## What is Fovea Studio?
Fovea Studio is a browser-based creative suite that converts audio tracks and lyrics into dynamic music videos:
- **Kinetic Posters**: Multi-line typography compositions with entrance and beat-reactive animations.
- **Apple Music-Style Scrolling Lyrics**: Fluid portrait lyrics with focus blur, ambient glow, and word-by-word active highlights.
- **Dual-Line Karaoke (KTV)**: Television-style alternating subtitles with smooth sweep timing.
- **AI Motion Director**: Analyzes musical cadence, tempo, and mood to suggest cohesive typography layouts and color palettes.
- **Hardware-Accelerated WebCodecs Export**: Fast 1080p MP4 exports directly in modern browsers, as well as cloud rendering.

## Who is it for?
- **Suno Music Creators**: Turn generated AI music and tracks into engaging visual content for social platforms.
- **Musicians and Producers**: Release lyric videos, teaser clips, and visualizers with zero video editing experience.
- **Content Creators and Labels**: Bulk-create vertical (9:16) and widescreen (16:9) music clips.

## Pricing & Credits
- **Free Trial**: 60 free permanent credits upon sign-up and email confirmation (makes about 2 complete lyric videos). No credit card required.
- **Creator Plan**: $9.99/month for 300 monthly credits (about 10 songs, ~$1 per completed song).
- **Pro Plan**: $19.99/month for 800 monthly credits (about 26 songs).
- **Per-Song Cost**: 30 credits per song — 20 credits for audio-to-lyric timing alignment (including vocal separation), and 10 credits for motion video rendering.
